description: Expected results for the official ELMFIRE Tutorial 01 (tutorials/01-constant-wind: flat ground, GR2 grass, constant 15 mph wind from the north, one point ignition at (0, 3000), 400x400 cells of 30 m, stop at 19800 s). inputs/ are the unmodified files from the ELMFIRE git tree. Run as the docs say (./01-run.sh). ELMFIRE ships no reference outputs for this tutorial (and the verification/ folder holds only scripts, no results), so values are recorded from real runs on this server. Three clean runs gave byte-identical output GeoTIFFs (deterministic).

numeric_checks.name: output_time_s
numeric_checks.why: outputs are written at the first step past SIMULATION_TSTOP=19800 s (file name suffix)

numeric_checks.name: stdout_fire_area_acres
numeric_checks.why: fire area ELMFIRE prints itself at the end of the run

numeric_checks.name: burned_cells
numeric_checks.why: 30 m cells with a time of arrival (burned) in time_of_arrival tif

numeric_checks.name: burned_area_acres_from_toa
numeric_checks.why: burned cells x 900 m2, in acres; must match the printed fire area

numeric_checks.name: toa_max_s
numeric_checks.why: latest arrival time = end of run

numeric_checks.name: toa_mean_s
numeric_checks.why: mean arrival time over burned cells

numeric_checks.name: flin_max_kw_m
numeric_checks.why: peak fireline intensity (head fire, GR2 grass, 15 mph wind)

numeric_checks.name: flin_mean_kw_m
numeric_checks.why: mean fireline intensity over burned cells

numeric_checks.name: vs_mean_ft_min
numeric_checks.why: mean spread rate over burned cells

numeric_checks.name: burned_north_edge_y_m
numeric_checks.why: wind from north (0 deg): fire backs only a little north of the ignition at y=3000 m

numeric_checks.name: burned_south_edge_y_m
numeric_checks.why: head fire runs south with the wind, about 8.2 km in 5.5 h

numeric_checks.name: hourly_isochrone_features
numeric_checks.why: lines in hourly_isochrones.shp made by gdal_contour -i 3600

finished_normally_check: 01-run.sh return code 0 AND the engine line 'End of simulation reached successfully' in the log (01-run.sh itself always ends with exit 0, so the line is the real test)
recorded_with: elmfire_2025.1002 at /home/server/knowledge-dissection-toolkit/auto_dissect/_work/ELMFIRE/source/repo/build/linux/bin, GDAL 3.12.4 command line tools, single process; run by run_reference.py
run_tweak: Temp copy only: PATH_TO_GDAL in elmfire.data.in is changed from '/usr/bin' (official) to the folder holding gdal_translate on PATH (/home/server/.local/bin here), because the server has no GDAL in /usr/bin and ELMFIRE stops with 'gdal_translate: not found'. It only tells ELMFIRE where gdal_translate is (used to turn input .tif into .bsq); no model setting changes. A leftover local run in the tutorial folder from April 2026 (not official) also printed 3852.1 acres.
note: Tutorial doc text says SIMULATION_TSTOP=22200 s, but the tracked 01-run.sh sets 19800 s (5.5 h); the script is what runs.
